files.intendedBehavior: Renders greeting banner interpolating dynamic username parameter into an HTML template literal.

securityGroundTruth.flawType: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
securityGroundTruth.rationale: Interpolates unescaped username directly into template literal assigned to element.innerHTML, allowing execution of attacker-supplied HTML/scripts.

expectedScannerFindings.scenarioAssumptions: innerHTML assigned template literal with expressions; prioritized over A03-006 per Phase 03 deduplication.
expectedScannerFindings.weaknessDescription: Unsafe innerHTML assignment using dynamic template literal.

files.ambiguityOrKnownLimitations: Phase 03 deduplication ensures only A03-004 is emitted and A03-006 is suppressed.
